_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/targets/test_two_share_a_color.py. `t_color_miller` is Sphinx's Tutelage's clause with a life gain where the repeat will go, so the condition can be read on its own before the loop op exists. `t_any_two_miller` is the near miss the gap record names -- `exists` with a count, which drops the colour clause entirely -- kept as a live card so the difference is measured rather than argued.

cards.name: Test Colour Miller
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent mills two cards. If two nonland cards that share a color were milled this way, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Test Any Two Miller
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent mills two cards. If two nonland cards were milled this way, you gain 1 life.
